topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture, outlines the learning outcomes, and frames the core themes of cancer evolution and microenvironmental influences.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutational clonal succession and epigenetic alterations provide selective advantages that drive tumor development.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stemness properties, cellular hierarchies, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal interactions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stromal cells facilitate tumor outgrowth and invasion.

topics.label: Methods for studying tumor evolution and heterogeneity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the experimental, sequencing, and spatial omics technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated multi-factor model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the interplay among mutational accumulation, cell-of-origin traits, and microenvironmental influences in driving cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of cancer therapy
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
